title: The Cactus Stone | 9 Bedroom 6.5 Bathroom 16+ Beds
description: Cactus Stone is a modern retreat featuring 9 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, 18 adult beds (no bunks) and over 8,000 square feet and a brand-new pickleball court. This fully upgraded home comfortably hosts 16+ guests and is perfect for a family getaway, golf trip, or company retreat. With top-tier amenities, unmatched privacy, and an ultra-convenient location, Cactus Stone offers the ultimate Scottsdale experience.
amenities: Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, Keurig coffee machine
Free driveway parking on premises – 4 spaces
Housekeeping available 2 hours a day, every day - available at extra cost
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

This house was perfect for a large group and entertaining! Even in 115 degree heat in the middle of July we were able to keep cool in the pool. Our group loved this home. Thank you for a trip we will never forget!
Beautiful home in Scottsdale, Host was very responsive, clean house heavily equipped, amazing amenities and you get more than what you’re paying for it!!

Fantastic place to stay! Quick 10 minute drive to downtown Scottsdale. The house is extremely spacious and well decorated. Love love love the pool and outdoor area. Overall, it’s the perfect oasis and couldn’t recommend it more! We definitely want to come back!

The home had a very nice layout and provided us with ample space to be together and when it was time to wind down relax in the bedrooms without feeling crammed.  The guest house was a great bonus and the backyard had some fun features for the kids to play and run free.   The kitchen had what we needed to cook for a large gathering.  Hosts were responsive and accommodating.
Excellent hosts, amazing space, perfect for a trip with friends.
